steps.title: Login first load under its limit
steps.extra: This step is the bundle fix of decision W18 (migration/refactor/auto-decisions-2026-10-22.md). Take api/message and api/bookmark (and api/update) out of the entry chunk: the app-start call in platform/bootstrap/startup.ts imports narrowly (deep import or a small module, static, same call order); get_IsUnsupportedSystem moves out of shared/**/lib/actions.ts so the lock dialog does not pull the bookmark and update domains. Target: Login first load at least 2.5 kB smaller (about 190.6 kB gzip or less); if not reached, also shrink the route table manifest. No behavior change: parity strict --all with the call check.
